interpretation: Symbolic approximation of a source-trained neural runoff fraction; not an identified physical law.
forecast_interpretation: Continuous simulation with observed daily weather; no discharge assimilation.

audit.observation_policy: First N available training-period labels; nested budgets; forcing-only state evolution
audit.units: Daily precipitation, PET, storage and discharge in mm; temperature in Celsius
audit.storage_equation: S_next = S + liquid - ET - Q; snow_next = snow + snowfall - melt
audit.runoff_equation: Q = overflow + retained * sigmoid(F(S/C, liquid/C, PET/C) + offset)
